about: Pre-production sheet for the board's Creative step (docs/proposals/2026-11-07-board-v4/PROPOSAL.md, sections A to G). Written 7 Nov 2026 before docs/PUBLISH_BOARDS.md documents a creative.json input; when it does, this file is reshaped to match.
